US Indicts Bishnoi, Adds Brar to Most Wanted List

The US has indicted Lawrence Bishnoi as part of "Operation Hard Ball." The FBI has also added Goldy Brar to its Most Wanted list, offering a reward for information leading to his arrest. This operation targets transnational criminal organizations.
